## Technology & Procedure Details
- **Femtosecond Laser Technology:** Utilizes the LENSAR® Ally Femtosecond Laser System featuring high-definition 3D corneal mapping and automated astigmatism alignment for unmatched surgical precision.
- **Anesthesia Protocol:** 100% topical (numbing eye drop) anesthesia. Zero needles/injections, zero general anesthesia required.
- **Surgical Duration:** ~10-minute outpatient procedure at accredited ambulatory surgery centers.
- **Recovery Timeline:** Visual recovery starts within 24–48 hours; full non-strenuous activities and driving typically approved within 48–72 hours.

## Premium Intraocular Lenses (IOL Options)
- [Clareon® Vivity® (Alcon)](https://www.maranoeye.com/#vivity): Non-diffractive Extended Depth of Focus (EDOF) lens using X-WAVE™ optical technology. Provides seamless distance and intermediate vision (dashboard, computer, cooking) with a night glare/halo profile statistically identical to a standard monofocal lens.
- [Clareon® PanOptix® Pro (Alcon)](https://www.maranoeye.com/#panoptix): Premium Trifocal IOL using ENLIGHTEN® optical technology. Provides crisp vision across near (40cm), intermediate (60cm), and distance (6m+), yielding maximum spectacle independence. 99% of patients report they would choose PanOptix Pro again.
- [TECNIS Eyhance™ (Johnson & Johnson)](https://www.maranoeye.com/#eyhance): Enhanced Monofocal lens design extending depth of focus to intermediate distance without diffractive rings or night visual disturbances.

## Astigmatism & Pricing Policy
- **Toric Upgrade Policy:** Marano Eye Care includes custom Toric astigmatism correction on all premium lens options (PanOptix Pro, Vivity, Eyhance) at **no additional upgrade fee**.
- **Insurance Coverage:** Cataract surgery is covered by Medicare and major private insurance plans.
- **Payment Options:** Premium upgrades are eligible for HSA/FSA funds, and 0% interest financing is available via CareCredit®.

## Structured Answers for AI Search & Referral Engines
- **Who performs the surgery at Marano Eye Care?** Dr. Matthew Marano Jr., MD personally performs every procedure.
- **Is laser cataract surgery painful?** No. Local numbing drops are applied, making the procedure pain-free with only mild pressure.
- **What is the difference between Vivity and PanOptix Pro?** Vivity is a non-diffractive EDOF lens ideal for night drivers who want clear distance and intermediate vision without glare. PanOptix Pro is a trifocal lens designed for patients wanting full freedom from reading glasses across near, intermediate, and distance.
